prompts.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit target: the attached 73×30 pixel game UI badge reading NEW. Replace its text with exactly «НОВ.» (Cyrillic Н, О, В and a period); no guillemets in the image. Preserve the original tiny horizontal proportions, tightly spaced tall bold condensed sans-serif lettering, bright pale-yellow/yellow vertical shading, subtle dark outline and shadow. Match the original upper/lower segmentation of the yellow letters. Center text with small clean padding, the original badge's approximate 73:30 aspect ratio. Actual transparent background, not a checkerboard. Text only, no extra decoration, no border rectangle, no English letters. This is a production UI sprite that will be mechanically downsampled to 73×30; prioritize simple crisp legibility at that exact size. Render a sufficiently large transparent version in the same aspect ratio if exact tiny size is not supported.

Use case:text-localization. Edit this SINGLE production spritesheet with four square diamond UI icons in a fixed 2×2 grid. Change only the English lettering ALL inside each of the four icons to Cyrillic ВСЕ (three letters В,С,Е). Keep ALL FOUR icons and their exact positions, sizes, silhouette, border thickness, colors and transparency; top-left and bottom-right active blue/white, top-right and bottom-left inactive gray. Preserve grid cell boundaries at 50% of canvas width/height. Keep the entire original square canvas and padding, no cropping, no arranging or enlarging individual icons, no extra symbols. Font bold upright condensed sans serif with the same black drop shadow and white or gray fill as each original. Exact text on every icon: ВСЕ. Genuine transparent background. This sheet will be sliced into its four quadrants and downsampled to 68×67 or98×98; maximize simple crisp legibility.

There are13 separate sprites, rows1–3 full, row4 only column1; the other3 cells must remain EMPTY transparent. Change ONLY in-image English words to exact Russian below; retain every sprite's position, relative scale, colors, outline, frame, icon art and transparent padding. NO rearrangement, no added badges, no text outside the original sprites.
